visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman with long dark hair wearing a striped tank top sitting behind a white table filled with anime-themed merchandise. She holds up two square cooler bags—one yellow with Winnie the Pooh and one blue with Mickey Mouse and Donald Duck—against a bright living room background with a large window and a grey sofa. (2) She focuses on the cooler bags, demonstrating their 15L capacity and showing the silver foil internal lining and Velcro closure to the camera. Her hands are seen clearly as she opens and closes the bags, while large yellow text overlays appear on the screen highlighting product details. (3) Transitioning to 'Dandadan' merchandise, she holds a large white Maneki-neko (Turbo Granny) piggy bank, smiling enthusiastically. A close-up shot shows a human hand inserting a coin into the slot on the back of the white cat-like figure, followed by her hugging a large plush version of the same character. (4) She then presents a 'Wind Breaker' figurine of the character Sakura Haruka, holding it on its stand with a small green leaf accessory. The lighting remains bright and even, casting soft shadows in the indoor setting as she points to the figurine's detailed features. (5) Moving to 'Jujutsu Kaisen', she holds a blind box and unboxes a small silver package to reveal a Gojo Satoru figurine, followed by a Nanami Kento figurine. She displays them close to the camera, with her facial expressions showing excitement and surprise as she reveals each character. (6) She holds a yellow 'Sakamoto Days' night light shaped like Taro Sakamoto; when she taps it, the figure glows with a warm yellow internal light. She gestures toward the glowing item with a soft smile, emphasizing its function as a bedside lamp in the cozy indoor environment. (7) She displays a set of six 'Sakamoto Days' acrylic stands on the table, moving them forward to showcase the different character illustrations. The camera framing is a medium shot that captures her upper body and the items spread across the table surface. (8) She showcases two canvas tote bags with 'Sakamoto Days' prints, putting one on her shoulder and holding the other to show the size and design. She demonstrates the bags' utility by placing small items inside, while the background remains the same well-lit domestic scene. (9) She reveals square 'Sakamoto Days' keychains from a blind box set, flipping them over to show the different illustrations on each side. Her fingers are visible as she handles the small items, bringing them close to the lens for clarity. (10) In the final phase, she waves to the camera while holding a large green plush glove and a keychain, as large promotional text overlays the bottom of the screen. She maintains high energy and a friendly expression throughout the conclusion of the video.
